title: SFO MLOps Trip - expenses & logistics scratchpad
content:
Purpose: Attend MLOps West (San Francisco) Mar 16-18 2026. Mix of talks + 1 sponsor table shift. This is my personal scratchpad for travel admin and expense reminders — rough, check before submitting.

Pre-trip TODOs:
- Finalize flight: booked on 2026-02-20 (AA 2752 LAX->SFO, itinerary ref: AA-9C7X). Keep boarding passes.
- Hotel: The Orchard Hotel SF, confirmation CONF-7890, check-in 3/15 check-out 3/19. Ask for itemized folio at checkout (mandatory for reimbursement). Contact: Stephanie Ramos, reservations@orchard-sf.com, +1 (415) 555-0142.
- Conference registration: badge pickup day 1; exhibitor contact Priya Desai (EventTree) priya@eventtree.com — ask for sponsorship invoice copy if needed.
- Ground transport: Lyft preferred for short trips, retain receipts. Shuttle to airport: QuickShuttle booking QS-448 (cancel if weather).

Expense categories & rules (quick reference):
- Airfare: full economy only unless pre-approved; keep e-ticket and seat upgrade receipts (upgrades require manager pre-approval -> non-reimbursable otherwise).
- Hotel: room + tax reimbursable; room upgrades or minibar charges need justification. Get folio.
- Meals: per diem guideline $75/day (company policy link in linked_artifacts). Exceptions for client dinners must list attendees and business purpose.
- Ground: rideshares + taxis reimbursable; parking reimbursable with receipt.
- Incidentals: laundry, dry-cleaning only on trips >5 days and with receipts and business justification.
- Non-reimbursable: personal entertainment, in-seat Wi‑Fi upgrades without approval, spouse/guest expenses.

Receipts & submission reminders:
- Upload receipts to Ramp within 7 days of expense. Use mobile app to scan immediately after card swipe. For paper receipts (hotel folio, taxis), scan as single PDF per vendor.
- Lost receipt protocol: email finance@redwood-inference.com with date/vendor/amount and brief context + manager approval line. Attach bank/cc statement if needed.
- Naming convention for uploads: YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount (e.g., 20260316_theorchard_347.20).
- For currency conversions (EUR/GBP): use credit card exchange rate on the statement; note conversion date.

Conference admin notes (day-level):
- 3/15 (Sunday) arrival: check-in, drop sponsor materials at exhibitor desk (table A3). Confirm table kit delivered.
- 3/16 (Mon) day 1: badge, keynote 9am, sponsor shift 12:30-2:00pm (Maya covering morning). Bring laptop charger + spare HDMI adapter.
- 3/17 (Tue) day 2: booth 10-4, evening sponsor dinner (company pays; submit attendee list).
- 3/18 (Wed) day 3: wrap, pack shipments back to office — coordinate with Solutions Eng for return labels.

Vendor & contact list (keep this handy):
- Hotel: The Orchard Hotel SF — Stephanie Ramos — reservations@orchard-sf.com — +1 415-555-0142 (folio requests).
- Conference ops: EventTree — Priya Desai — priya@eventtree.com — sponsor invoices / exhibitor logistics.
- AV supplier: BayAV — contact Marco Silva — marco@bayav.com — booth A3 AV pickup 3/15 6pm.
- Freight/shipments: ShipQuick — pickup window 3/18 5pm — booking SQ-331.

Reimbursement examples (text snippets to drop in Ramp expense description):
- "Airfare: AA2752 LAX→SFO 2026-03-15 — economy fare — business travel to MLOps West — Taylor Nguyen"
- "Hotel: The Orchard Hotel — 3 nights (itemized folio attached) — room & tax — business travel MLOps West"
- "Meals: 2026-03-16 — client dinner with Acme Corp (Jane Doe, John Smith) — agenda: integration kickoff — per diem override requested"

Budget check (estimate):
- Air: $210 (roundtrip booked)
- Hotel: $330/night x3 = $990 + taxes (~$115)
- Meals: $75/day x4 = $300
- Ground & misc: $120
- Total est: ~$1,735 (submit actuals)

Edge cases / notes to self:
- If billed by conference as "sponsorship fee" ask finance to code to marketing/sales budget — need PO number.
- If shipping demo hardware to venue, confirm insurance & declared value. Solutions Eng to approve.
- Keep copy of exhibitor kit checklist in Dropbox: local path may be shared post-event.

Post-trip deliverables:
- Upload all receipts and card statement snippet to Ramp within 7 days of return.
- Expense report: complete by 2026-03-27 (two weeks after end date) — otherwise finance may delay.
- Quick debrief email to Eng Applied ML: wins/contacts + any followups for hiring/networking.

Random scratch items (to tidy later):
- Pack spare business cards (50) — ask SE team for new batch if low.
- Bring spare mask + hand sanitizer (venue policies may change).
- Swap demo laptop power cable for universal one.

TODO (short):
- [ ] Confirm exhibitor shipping label details with Marco (BayAV).
- [ ] Get pre-approval if planning to upgrade any flight segment.
- [ ] Print hotel folio checklist and envelope for receipts.
- [ ] Drop itinerary + emergency contact with manager (Jordan).

End of scratchpad. Will convert to formal travel packet once confirmed.
